items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: He was about Johnny's height, you know. ... But Johnny and Harry still, they wanted Hilton Jefferson in there in Hardwick's place. ... when Johnny came back.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Yeah, that could be a hangup.
It was. It was with him. And he was a little guy, like Johnny, too. He was about Johnny's height, you know.
